sample.description: PSE stock closing prices via fastquant Phisix cache (merged_stock_data.zip) searched 2015-01-01 to 2022-12-31 per paper; DFM fitting period 2015-01-01 to 2020-12-31 T=1456 N=72 actual cache coverage 2010-01-04 to 2021-12-15 (2022-01-01 to 2022-12-31 missing, 1 year). Filter >1% missing retains 72/72 (all pass). PSEi proxy equal-weighted mean return (PSEI.PS/^PSEI delisted, stooq JS proof-of-work blocked, logged). GDP quarterly World Bank annual NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG 2015-2022 interpolated to quarterly (paper quarterly source not stated; PSA 403, FRED timeout). Nowcasting in 2015Q1-2020Q4 out 2021Q1-2022Q4 searched, available out 2021Q1-2021Q4 (4 obs, 2022 4 quarters missing due to cache). Factors via PCA proxy (DynamicFactor MLE not convergent for 72x1456).
sample.differences: Stock sample identical 72 tickers for 2015-2020 window. Searched full paper window 2015-01-01 to 2022-12-31 but public fastquant cache ends 2021-12-15, so 2022-01-01 to 2022-12-31 (252 trading days, 4 quarterly GDP obs) missing from our sample; out-of-sample truncated to 2021Q1-2021Q4 (listed as missing). PSEi: attempted stooq https://stooq.com/q/d/?s=%5Epsei (returns 796b anti-bot requiring crypto subtle proof-of-work) and yfinance PSEI.PS/^PSEI/^PSE – all MarketDataUnavailable logged – fallback equal-weighted proxy vs paper stooq PSEi. GDP: paper quarterly source not stated; PSA 403 Cloudflare + 7 FRED candidates timed out 10s → World Bank annual interpolated. DFM: PCA+VAR OLS proxy vs authors Kalman MLE via DynamicFactorAnalysis (statsmodels DynamicFactor failed for large panel).

not_rebuilt.estimate_loading_beta_i_sigma_i_one_fact: Full MLE loadings table 144 values requires authors Kalman MLE via DynamicFactorAnalysis package; PCA proxy loadings differ numerically. Public Phisix cache vintage (2021-12-15) not exact paper vintage.
not_rebuilt.estimate_loading_beta1i_beta2i_sigma_i_t: Same for 216 values with ns flags; significance requires MLE standard errors not available via PCA proxy.

sample.substitutions: fastquant cache merged_stock_data.zip vs live Phisix per-day API (same data, vintage 2021-12-15, missing 2022). PSEi equal-weighted mean return proxy vs stooq PSEi (attempted fetches logged as MarketDataUnavailable). CAPM Cov/Var computed proxy vs Barrons (get_profile unavailable logged). GDP World Bank annual NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG interpolated to quarterly vs PSA quarterly (FRED timeout, PSA 403). PCA+VAR OLS proxy vs DynamicFactorAnalysis Kalman MLE (statsmodels fit attempted, non-convergence). ffill for sparse misses (0.07-0.48% per stock).

notes: Choices and deviations: Missing price handling – paper drops stocks >1% missing but not how to handle remaining sparse misses (0.07-0.48% per stock, 61 missing dates affecting 109 pct_change rows); we forward-filled closes to keep balanced panel T=1456 (alternative listwise deletion T=1348 more loss). Return definition simple percentage (S_t-S_{t-1})/S_{t-1} as stated. Lag orders paper BIC (1,3,5) and (2,2,5) retained as parameters (we verified IC1-IC3 lower for n=1,2 vs 0 white-noise, but IC best n=4 in our centering due to demean choice vs paper n=1). Estimation paper Kalman filter+smoother + MLE via DynamicFactorAnalysis; we attempted statsmodels.tsa.statespace.DynamicFactor (k_factors,factor_order,error_order) with maxiter 5 – failed/ non-convergent for 72x1456 panel (logged), fallback to PCA SVD (U*s) + VAR OLS – consistent under large N,T but not exact MLE, hence loadings/ VAR coefficients proxies differ from paper. PSEi paper cites https://stooq.com/q/d/?s=%5Epsei but site now requires JS proof-of-work (796b anti-bot with crypto SHA256, logged as 200 with script) and yfinance PSEI.PS/^PSEI/PSEI delisted empty (MarketDataUnavailable logged for 8 tickers) – used equal-weighted market return as theory-consistent proxy. CAPM beta via Barrons no stable API, get_profile(beta) unavailable logged, computed Cov(Ri,Rm)/Var(Rm) definition underlying Eq1. GDP paper not stating source; PSA/psa.gov.ph blocked 403 Cloudflare Just-a-moment, 7 FRED IDs (NGDPNSAXDCPPH etc) timed out 10s after 10s, World Bank annual available (6.34,7.14,6.93,6.34,6.12,-9.52,5.71,7.58) interpolated repeating annual for 4 quarters; searched 2022Q1-2022Q4 but 4 quarters missing due cache (reported via missing/differences). Nowcasting monthly indicators mean+std F1t,F2t per month (4 per month, 12 per quarter) via OLS; reduced to 4 quarterly avg (F1_mean,F1_std,F2_mean,F2_std) when n
